subject: Pricing follow-up: AWS Marketplace private offer unit-price mapping

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + next steps on AWS marketplace private offer pricing

Alex — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment going into procurement: 

What we covered
- BrightCart anticipated usage: 200M tokens/month baseline, 400–500M tokens/month at peak (Q1 ramp).
- Primary use: user-facing product generation + reranking; latency SLOs required.
- Procurement path: AWS Marketplace private offer preferred (BrightCart procurement already uses marketplace for other SaaS).

Open asks we agreed to: 
1) Mapping from Redwood unit price to Marketplace list price (accounting for AWS marketplace fee) so we can propose a private offer unit price that meets BrightCart's target budget.
2) Confirmation of BrightCart target $/1M tokens and monthly commit window for private offer (term 12/24 months).
3) Attachments: I’m attaching a simple pricing model (brightcart_pricing_model.xlsx) and an internal fee calc doc.

What I heard from you today (please correct if wrong):
- target blended customer price: ~$10–$15 per 1M tokens (goal is to keep overall inference spend predictable)
- preferred contract: 12 months with 20% annual growth review

Next steps
- Alex: confirm exact target $/1M tokens (pick a single target or a tiered target for baseline vs peak).
- Marissa/Aditya: I’ll map Redwood list price -> AWS marketplace list price so the net to Redwood aligns with your target.
- Once we agree on target and volumes, we’ll loop in Camila (finance) and Avery (sales manager) to prep a marketplace private offer draft.

Thanks — looking forward to the numbers.

—

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the numbers and a couple clarifying points: 

BrightCart confirmed targets
- Baseline: 200M tokens/month
- Target steady-state: 350M tokens/month
- Peak (seasonal): 500M tokens/month
- Target blended customer price: $12 / 1M tokens (we’d consider $10–14 acceptable but prefer single number for PO)

Marketplace details from procurement (high level)
- BrightCart prefers AWS Private Offer via Marketplace. Procurement noted that marketplace list price should include AWS fees so the net Redwood receives equals the negotiated price.
- They called out standard AWS marketplace fee at ~20% for private offer transactions (we expect this to be reflected in the offer).

Questions for Redwood
1) Can you map the $12/1M target to the required AWS marketplace list price (assuming 20% marketplace fee)?
2) Any minimum commitment cadence you recommend for billing/usage reconciliation?
3) Can you provide a sample line item we can show our procurement team for the PO?

We’re aiming to have procurement ready to review a PO/offer draft by the end of next week (10/28).

Thanks — Alex

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Post-demo recap + next steps on AWS marketplace private offer pricing

Alex / team — looping in a couple quick calculations (attaching aws_marketplace_fee_calcs.pdf). I kept this intentionally simple so procurement can see the math.

Assumptions used
- BrightCart target net price to Redwood: $12 per 1M tokens
- AWS marketplace fee: 20% (marketplace retains 20% of list price)
- Redwood target margin on private offer: 25% above our marginal cost (example cost here is illustrative)

Step 1 — list price calculation to hit $12 net after 20% fee
- Let P = marketplace list price. Net to Redwood = P * (1 - 0.20) = 0.8 * P
- To get Net = $12 => 0.8 * P = 12 => P = 12 / 0.8 = $15.00 per 1M tokens

Step 2 — sanity check vs internal economics (example numbers)
- Example Redwood internal cost (infra + infra ops + model license amortized): $8.00 per 1M tokens
- If list price is $15.00, net to Redwood after AWS fee = $12.00; Gross margin = (12 - 8) / 12 = 33% (or markup of 50% over cost)
- After account-level discounts or marketplace incentives we may need to adjust list price by +/\u2212 $0.50–$1.50 depending on committed volume and term.

Recommendations for PO line items to share with procurement
- Proposal A (standard): 
  - Unit: 1M tokens
  - List price (AWS Marketplace private offer): $15.00 / 1M tokens
  - Billing cadence: monthly, with quarterly reconciliation against usage
  - Term: 12 months; optional 12-month renewal with 3% price escalation
- Proposal B (volume tier): baseline commit 200M/mo at $14.25 / 1M (net ~$11.40), overage at $15.50 / 1M

Notes
- If BrightCart wants a lower list price we’ll need either a higher commit or a longer term (24–36 months) to preserve margin.
- For GCP/Azure marketplace flows we’ll run a similar calc but adjust the marketplace fee assumption (GCP tends to be ~15% marketplace fee; Azure varies).

I attached the calcs and a sample line-item. Happy to jump on a short call with procurement if they want to run through the math.

—
